Image converter FAQ

Format support, privacy, and batch conversion answers.

A quick guide for JPG to PNG, PNG to WebP, WebP to JPG, metadata, uploads, and supported image formats.

Can I use PixConvertly as a JPG to PNG converter?

Yes. Upload one or more JPG images, choose PNG as the output format, and download the converted PNG files individually or as a ZIP.

Can PixConvertly convert PNG to WebP for smaller website images?

Yes. Choose WebP output, adjust quality if needed, and PixConvertly will convert PNG files locally in your browser for lighter web-friendly images.

Can I convert WebP to JPG?

Yes. PixConvertly supports WebP to JPG conversion for compatibility with tools, forms, and platforms that do not accept WebP files.

Are my files uploaded?

No. PixConvertly converts images locally in your browser with the Canvas API, so selected files are not uploaded to our server.

Is image metadata removed?

Canvas conversion usually strips most embedded metadata, including many EXIF fields. Browser behavior can vary, so avoid treating it as a guaranteed forensic metadata cleaner.

Which formats are supported?

You can upload JPG, PNG, WebP, or HEIC/HEIF images and export them as JPG, PNG, WebP, or AVIF when your browser supports AVIF encoding. Batch downloads are packaged as a ZIP file.
